chunks: And led them to the path that is straight.
ai.seo_question: What does the 'straight path' refer to in Surah An-Nisa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific group of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who are viewed as the living embodiment of the Straight Path. It underscores the necessity of divine guidance (Tawfiq) alongside human effort, affirming that true adherence to the path requires both following the Prophet's teachings and recognizing the authority of the Imams as the interpreters of that truth.
